title: Adjective As A 2d Vector, Habit As Object Automati 260715 073739.sdocx
author: Ben Tristan Martin
description: TOFA ADDENDUM: ADJECTIVAL GEOMETRY, INTENTIONAL BLINDNESS, AND THE COGNITIVE KILLING FLOOR 1. Adjectives as the Depth Axis of 2D Semantic Space 1.1 Love is not an abstract, unexplained construct floating in a vacuum. Love is a tangible thing within logical space—it can be felt, converted, and its traces leave unmistakable physical and emotional effects in 3D reality. 1.2 To give love shape, we must understand the function of adjectives. If depth is the spatial axis that lifts 2D geometry into 3D reality, then adjectives act as the depth axis for 2D semantic space. 1.3 Imagine a baseline ocean of a concept (e.g., "Love"). Adjectives represent vector modifications that raise or lower the thing's position along this vertical axis. 1.4 "Tough love" applies a positive modifier, raising the coordinate slightly above the surface tension of the baseline ocean. "Greedy love" applies a negative, entropic modifier, sinking the coordinate directly below the surface into darkness. Adjectives are the literal structural mechanism that determines the elevation and quality of a semantic thing within the matrix. 2. Intentional Blindness & The Mechanics of Habit 2.1 Habit is the systematic elimination of self-reflexivity. When a human subject relies entirely on schemas, they stop observing reality and start projecting an internal script. 2.2 The pantry phenomenon (being unable to see the object 5cm away because it violates the projected schema of "where it belongs") is macro-proof of this limit. The subject's habit creates a localized structural blindness. 2.3 This becomes evil when applied to sentient life. Humans deliberately invent schemas—like the unbiblical, self-aggrandising lie that "animals have no souls"—specifically to justify convenience, greed, and gluttony. It is a refusal to see the self in the "Other." 3. The Slaughterhouse Thought Experiment: Babies with Shotguns 3.1 The human criteria for "sentience" or "soul" are completely arbitrary wanks designed to privilege the human way of seeing. 3.2 A cow is a gentle, highly empathetic soul-being with an absolute right to exist and experience happiness within its own 3D geometric perch. 3.3 The ultimate proof of human awareness of this shared subjectivity is the architecture of the slaughterhouse. The engineering of a "blind corridor" to hide the killing floor isn't because the cow is a "dumb object." It is done precisely because the handlers know the cow possesses deep, self-reflexive terror and empathy. They must actively engineer the animal's blindness to prevent its stress from "ruining the meat." 3.4 This is the ultimate expression of greed: farming a soul-being from birth, trapping them in a prison of destiny, and then throwing away their body parts because a fuckwit overcooked it. If a hyper-intelligent alien species did this to our children—to Heath, Mischa, or Angus—it would be recognized instantly as cosmic horror.

title: 中国外来植物的物种组成、区系特征及影响因素分析
author: 张金梦, 朱亮亮, 印浩楠, 王丽, 刘玉莉.中国外来植物的物种组成、区系特征及影响因素分析.广西植物:https://chinaxiv.org/abs/202503.00204.[ChinaXiv:202503.00204V1]
description: 中国外来植物的物种组成、区系特征及影响因素分析 后印本 Species composition, floristic characteristics and influencing factors of alien plants in China 作者： 张金梦 1 朱亮亮 1 印浩楠 1 王丽 1 刘玉莉 2* 作者单位： 1. 江苏第二师范学院地理科学学院，南京211200 2. 湖州师范学院可持续发展研究院，浙江湖州313000 提交时间： 2025-03-19 11:24:41 摘要: 中国是遭受生物入侵危害和威胁最严重的国家之一，掌握全国尺度上外来植物的物 种组成、区系特征及其影响因素对减少外来植物的入侵风险和促进防控管理至关重要。该文 以《中国外来植物数据集》为基础，统计分析其物种组成、生活型、区系类型等特征，并利 用相关性分析和逐步回归模型深入探究了社会经济和生态因素与外来植物之间的关联机理。 结果表明：（1）我国已有的外来植物中大型科（99 科，13 741 种）和大型属（205 属，7 199 种）对总物种数的贡献率分别为93.41%和48.94%。从生活型组成看，草本植物构成了我国 外来植物的主体，占比59.82%。（2）全国范围内热带成分科占据明显优势，占总科数的 52.65%；其次分别为温带成分科（21.56%）和世界广布科（20.49%）。（3）外来植物总数 的分布格局支持了各区系成分科的分布格局，即东部沿海和西南地区的外来植物总数和各区 系成分最丰富，向内陆减少。然而，北方省市的世界广布和温带成分科的比重较高，南方省 市的热带成分科的占比最高。（4）相关性分析表明入侵植物所在科的入侵种数与该科所包 含的外来种数存在显著正相关关系。各省市经济因素和气候条件共同决定了我国外来植物总 数和各区系成分科数的空间分布格局，但各区系成分占比主要受热量条件（年均温）的影响。 未来我国应大力加强对具有热带性质和世界广布的大科、大属的草本植物的引种评估与监管。 外来植物 区系成分 物种组成 多样性 分布格局 分类： 生物学 >> 植物学 >> 应用植物学 期刊： 广西植物 投稿状态： 已在期刊出版 引用： ChinaXiv:202503.00204 (或此版本 ChinaXiv:202503.00204V1 ) DOI:10.11931/guihaia.gxzw202405030 CSTR:32003.36.ChinaXiv.202503.00204 推荐引用方式： 张金梦,朱亮亮,印浩楠,王丽,刘玉莉.中国外来植物的物种组成、区系特征及影响因素分析.广西植物:https://chinaxiv.org/abs/202503.00204.[ChinaXiv:202503.00204V1] 版本历史 [V1] 2025-03-19 11:24:41 ChinaXiv:202503.00204V1 下载全文

title: AN ULTRAMODERN PORTRAYAL OF SITA IN AMISH TRIPATHY'S NOVEL 'SITA: THE WARRIOR OF MITHILA'- A STUDY
author: Dr. Rajbir Singh
description: This paper delineats the portrayal of Sita in Amish Tripathy's novel ' Sita: The Warrior of Mithila' and her relevance in the' Ramayana' where Sita is depicted as a devoted wife,daughter and a silent visionary. She is always behind the customs and traditions which may be relevant in that particular  context. She is full of love and compassion and her patience can be judged with the fact that she accepts meekly what is imposed on her . She remains  as pure as Gangajal in spite of so many hardships and ordeal in her life. Religion is every thing to him. Tripathy's Sita is endowed with extraordinary courage ,wisdom,devotion,love,compassion,martial art, war strategy and physical strength. She is ready to break all the 'Man Centred shackles'. She is able to rule , enjoy her strength and independence. Amish has his own vision and thinking which brings her out in the ' Forest of Enchantments' where she presents her in bold terms . Coming out in new horizon has different connotations-Sita not only puts her feet boldly in an alien world but she remains virtouos and optimistic in different unforeseen circumstances. She is a torch bearer for the whole class by representing her strong values, patience,devotion,mititary art and novel thinking.

Além de ser um importante centro de extração, a cidade também se destaca no beneficiamento e exportação de mármore e granito, sendo reconhecida como a capital nacional do mármore e granito. O Espírito Santo, de forma geral, é o estado que lidera a produção e exportação de rochas ornamentais no país.  *🔍 FIQUE SABENDO* 🗣 "Tenro" é um adjetivo que descreve algo que é macio, mole, suave ao toque ou fácil de cortar, geralmente usado para alimentos, especialmente carnes, frutas ou vegetais. Quando dizemos que uma carne está tenra, significa que ela está bem cozida, macia e fácil de mastigar. Também pode ser usado de forma figurada para se referir a algo delicado, sensível ou em estágio inicial de desenvolvimento, como em "idade tenra" (idade jovem ou infância) ou "tenro sentimento" (emoção ainda nova ou sensível) FONTE: IA *✈️ TURISMO* 🏙 Cuiabá, capital do estado de Mato Grosso, é um destino que surpreende pela diversidade cultural, história rica e localização estratégica. Conhecida como “Portal da Amazônia”, a cidade é também um importante ponto de acesso ao Pantanal, à Chapada dos Guimarães e à Floresta Amazônica, tornando-se um excelente ponto de partida para o ecoturismo no Brasil. Fundada no século XVIII durante o ciclo do ouro, Cuiabá ainda preserva traços da arquitetura colonial em seu centro histórico, com igrejas, casarões e praças que contam a história da ocupação da região. O clima é quente e seco durante boa parte do ano, o que impulsiona atividades ao ar livre, como passeios pelos parques urbanos, como o Parque Mãe Bonifácia e o Parque Tia Nair, que oferecem trilhas, áreas de lazer e contato com a natureza no meio da cidade. [02/07/2025 06:03] Marcos Vinicius: Além das belezas naturais, a cultura cuiabana é marcada pela forte influência indígena, africana e portuguesa. Isso se reflete na gastronomia típica, com pratos como a farofa de banana, o mojica de pintado, o arroz com pequi e o tradicional peixe assado, todos preparados com ingredientes locais. A cidade também é famosa por suas festas populares e danças tradicionais, como o siriri e o cururu. Para quem busca aventura e natureza, Cuiabá está a cerca de 70 km da Chapada dos Guimarães, um dos mais belos parques nacionais do Brasil, conhecido por suas formações rochosas, cachoeiras e mirantes espetaculares. Ao sul, o Pantanal oferece experiências únicas com safáris fotográficos, observação de aves e passeios de barco por entre a vida selvagem. Com sua localização privilegiada, calor humano e riqueza cultural, Cuiabá é um destino que conquista tanto os amantes da natureza quanto os interessados em história e tradição brasileira.  FONTE: IA *🍽 CULINARIA* *🍽 Nome do prato: Tutu de Feijão* 🥛 Ingredientes: 2 xícaras de feijão cozido (com caldo) 1 xícara de farinha de mandioca (ou de milho, se preferir) 1 cebola média picada 2 dentes de alho picados 100g de bacon picado 1 linguiça calabresa fatiada 2 colheres de sopa de óleo ou banha Sal e pimenta-do-reino a gosto Cheiro-verde picado para finalizar 🥄 Modo de preparo: Em uma panela, aqueça o óleo (ou a banha) e doure o bacon. Acrescente a linguiça calabresa e frite até ficar bem dourada. Em seguida, junte a cebola e o alho, refogando até ficarem macios. Adicione o feijão cozido com um pouco do caldo (se estiver muito grosso, adicione um pouco de água). Misture bem e deixe ferver por alguns minutos. Aos poucos, acrescente a farinha, mexendo sempre para não empelotar, até atingir uma consistência cremosa, nem muito líquida, nem muito seca. Ajuste o sal e a pimenta. Finalize com cheiro-verde picado e sirva quente, como acompanhamento de carnes, arroz ou couve refogada.  FONTE: IA

title: ERIC ED581044: Proceedings of the 2015 Annual Meeting of the Canadian Mathematics Education Study Group = Actes De La Rencontre Annuelle 2015 Du Groupe Canadien D'etude en Didactique Des Mathematiques (39th, Moncton, New Brunswick, Canada, June 5-9, 2015)
author: ERIC
description: This submission contains the Proceedings of the 2015 Annual Meeting of the Canadian Mathematics Education Study Group (CMESG), held at the Université de Moncton in Moncton, New Brunswick. The CMESG is a group of mathematicians and mathematics educators who meet annually to discuss mathematics education issues at all levels of learning. The aims of the Study Group are: to advance education by organizing and coordinating national conferences and seminars to study and improve the theories of the study of mathematics or any other aspects of mathematics education in Canada at all levels; and to undertake research in mathematics education and to disseminate the results of this research. These proceedings include plenary lectures, an elder talk memoire, panel discussions, working group reports, topic sessions, new PhD reports, and summaries of ad hoc and poster sessions. Papers include: (1) Diversité, variabilité et convergence des pratiques enseignantes/Diversity, Variability, and Commonalities Among Teaching Practices (Éric Roditi) [Written in French]; (2) Connections: Mathematical, Interdisciplinary, Electronic, and Personal (Deborah Hughes Hallet); (3) Task Design and Problem Posing (Ami Mamolo and John McLoughlin); (4) Indigenous Ways of Knowing in Mathematics (Lisa Lunney Borden and Florence Glanfield); (5) Theoretical Frameworks in Mathematics Education Research/Les cadres théoriques dans la recherche en didactique des mathématiques (Jérôme Proulx and Anna Sierpinska) [Written in English and French]; (6) Early Years Teaching, Learning and Research: Tensions in Adult-Child Interactions Around Mathematics (Ann Anderson and Helena P. Osana); (7) Innovations in Tertiary Mathematics Teaching, Learning and Research/Innovations au post-secondaire pour l'enseignement, l'apprentissage et la recherché (Taras Gula and Denis Tanguay) [Written in English and French]; (8) Some Thoughts on Mathematics as the Alien Word (Richard Barwell); (9) Interaction Between a Mathematics Department in a University and the School System/Interaction entre un département de mathématiques universitaire et le système scolaire (Paul Deguire) [Written in English and French]; (10) Building Thinking Classrooms: Conditions for Problem Solving (Peter Liljedahl); (11) Growing Mathematical Understanding and Folding Back: The Individual, the Collective, the Teacher (Lyndon Martin); (12) De la « clochette de vigilance » au changement de posture: Quelques questions issues de la didactique des mathématiques et étudiées depuis la didactique du sens commun/From the Use of an "Alert Bell" to a Change of Posture: Some Questions Emerging from the Didactics of Mathematics Being Studied by the Didactics of Common Sense (Sophie René de Cotret) [Written in French and English]; (13) Secondary School Mathematics Teacher Candidates' Research, Pedagogical, and Content Knowledge (Alexander Antropov); (14) Étude des significations de la multiplication pour différents ensembles de nombres dans un contexte de géométrisation…et un aperçu de quelques réflexions d'ordre épistémologique (Raquel Isabel Barrera Curin) [Written in French]; (15) The Role of Drawing in Arithmetic Word Problem Solving: Microanalysis of the Subject/Material Dialectic (Élysée-Robert Cadet); (16) Histoire des mathématiques dans la formation des enseignants du secondaire : Une narration polyphonique sur la fragilité, l'adversité et l'empathie--Résumé de thèse/History of Mathematics in a Preservice Teacher's Training Context: A Polyphonic Narration on Fragility, Adversity and Empathy--Thesis Summary (David Guillemette) [Written in French and English]; (17) Improving Mathematics Teaching Through Professional Learning Groups (Jennifer Holm); (18) Mathematics Problems and Thinking Mathematically in Undergraduate Education (Asia R. Matthews); (19) Understanding Learning in Mathematics Through the Metaphor of Authoring (P. Janelle McFeetors); (20) How Elementary Students Learn to Mathematically Analyze Word Problems: The Case of Addition and Subtraction (Elena Polotskaia); (21) Le concept de variabilité chez des enseignants de mathématiques au secondaire (Sylvain Vermette) [Written in French]; (22) Lesson and Learning Study: Collaborative Learning Structures for Preservice Teacher Education (Diana Royea); and (23) Hear My Voice: Teachers' Stories (Ann Kajander and Jennifer Holm). Individual papers contain references. [For the 2014 proceedings, see ED581042.]

title: ERIC EJ1057352: A Defining Moment in E-Working: The Application of an E-Working Definition to the Education Context
author: ERIC
description: Using qualitative data gathered through 144 questionnaires completed online by education sector personnel, this paper examines the relevance of a definition of e-working to the educational context. It identifies that the definition, which draws on and extends existing knowledge and identifies e-working to be a way of being a worker as well as a way or a mechanism for carrying out the work task, has clear potential to be applied within the education sector. The paper identifies that it is not the composite elements of the definition which may appear alien to the worker in the educational context, but instead inference drawn from the way in which the e-working term has hitherto been regarded.
